notes: Each מִן of this verse is aligned to the whole *out of*, headed on *out* under rule 24; the Hiphil participles take only *brought*. The competing reading treats *out* as the Hiphil's phrasal particle.
The second participial article (s028) is unrepresented under rules 22 and 47: the ASV writes one *who* for the coordinated attributives.
The resumptive suffix of בָּהּ is unrepresented under rule 22, the relative and the preposition each holding a written word of their own (*which* … *in*), so no fused pronominal adverb arises.
